Package com.egradx.notification

Class EgradxNotificationAuditActions

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.notification.EgradxNotificationAuditActions
All Implemented Interfaces:
EgradxAuditActionCatalog
public final class EgradxNotificationAuditActions extends Object implements EgradxAuditActionCatalog
What egradx-notification records: changes to what it sends and how, and sends made by hand. It publishes them as EgradxAuditEvents; egradx-audit, when present, stores them. A channel's secret is never in a record — only whether it changed.
